headline: Irish Services Sector Inflation Accelerates to Three-Year High
summary: Inflation in Ireland's services sector surged to its highest level in three years, driven by sustained increases in commercial fuel and energy expenses.
why: Services inflation is monitored closely by central banks as an indicator of underlying domestic price pressures.

impacts.name: Ireland
impacts.why: Accelerating services costs increase operational expenditure for local business enterprises.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
